description:
FAA Sources Sought 6973GH-25-R-00167 to establish a Qualified Vendors List (QVL) for construction services performed on AJW-242 Unstaffed Infrastructure Sustainment (UIS) facilities on and off Airport Operating Areas in various US locations has been completed. The approved contractors are listed on the attached spreadsheet under the Attachments/Links section in sam.gov.

For questions regarding the announcement please contact the contracting officer, Janice Hammonds, at janice.hammonds@faa.gov or 405-954-7705.
